text.p: Bastia confirmed their French title credentials with a 3-1 home win over Bordeaux in a clash between the third and fourth-placed teams in the first division on Thursday.

The Corsicans climbed to within one point of second-placed Paris Saint-Germain, at home to Montpellier on Friday, and three behind leaders Monaco, away to Lens. They also widened their advantage over Bordeaux to five points.
Yugoslavia striker Anton Drobnjak opened the scoring for the home side with his 12th goal of the season in the 19th minute.
Sebastian Perez increased the lead six minutes later with a free-kick and another defender, Patrick Moreau, headed the third on the stroke of halftime.
Midfielder Didier Tholot pulled one back for Bordeaux, missing suspended striker Jean-Pierre Papin, five minutes before the interval.
